claim_text: Sara Netanyahu said Yair Golan was already there, dressed and ready, very early on October 7 while others, including Prime Minister Netanyahu, still did not know war had broken out.
discovery_sources: Channel 14 original interview/follow-up; NPR direct Yair Golan interview republished by KAXE; Jerusalem Post Netanyahu timeline; Channel 14 response/limiting context
resolution_notes: Narrow verdict: False on chronology only. Golan's direct Nov. 2023 account says he put on his uniform around 08:00–08:30, went first to Home Front Command, obtained a rifle and only then drove south; Netanyahu's reported notification time is 06:29. The item expressly preserves Sara Netanyahu's later statement that she was not part of betrayal theories and her lawyer's argument that the remarks were sarcastic criticism of those who failed to update the PM. No broader conspiracy allegation or motive is inferred.
media_status: Exact original Channel 14 interview video recovered. Stable GitHub preview remains Blocked because an exact video frame could not be extracted reliably; the separate ChatGPT-generated Channel 14 article illustration was rejected as non-exact media and no substitute preview was used.
